description: This file is a shell script configuring GRE tunnels, network interfaces, and system events for a hotspot device, including setting up bridges, IP configurations, and iptables rules.

methods.name: init_snooper_sysevents
methods.description: Enables snooper circuit and remote system events.

methods.name: read_init_params
methods.description: Retrieves configuration parameters from PSM database.

methods.name: create_tunnel
methods.description: Creates GRE tunnel and configures network interfaces and bridges.

methods.name: init_keepalive_sysevents
methods.description: Initializes system events related to keepalive settings.

methods.name: update_bridge_config
methods.description: Sets iptables rules for network traffic filtering.
